items.question: Do you cover weddings outside Northumberland?
items.answer: We photograph weddings and family sessions across Northumberland.

items.question: Will you make us pose for photographs?
items.answer: No. We work in a relaxed documentary style with no forced poses.

items.question: Can we get our photographs as an album?
items.answer: Yes, albums are printed in the UK, so you have something to hold and keep.

items.question: Do you photograph family sessions too?
items.answer: Yes, alongside weddings we photograph family sessions in the same relaxed style.
